brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested Youssef Hussain Basharats from his tent in Khallet Makhoul in the northern Jordan Valley, Shehab Wire reported. The arrest took place at the man's residence in the sparsely populated area of the occupied West Bank.

The northern Jordan Valley has been a flashpoint for Israeli military operations and settler activity. Palestinian communities in the region, many of whom live in informal settlements and tented encampments, face frequent Israeli raids and restrictions on movement. No details were immediately available regarding the circumstances of Basharats's detention or any charges he may face.
